sd.pick: Choose a municipality – the city page applies per municipality.
sd.noLedger: not measured yet (builds up with the next runs)
sd.how: Fleet = all operators' e-scooters in the municipality's open feeds (available, reserved, disabled) against the official cap from data/reference.json. Feed availability = share of collector runs in the calendar year in which the operator's feed delivered current or slightly delayed data; the weakest operator is shown, target {target}. Idle over 72 h = vehicles not moved for more than three days, out of all vehicles with a known idle time.
sd.alarmsSub: Cap, source down, zones, prices and fleet jump – detected by comparing with the collector's previous run.
sd.noAlarms: No alerts in the last 7 days.
sd.noAlarmsHint: Checked on every collector run (about every 18 minutes).
sd.feedsSub: Atom feeds per topic for feed readers, e-mail services or Teams channels.
aufl.pick: Choose a municipality – data obligations apply per municipality.
aufl.kOkCmp: operators with at least {target} this year
aufl.how: Availability = share of collector runs in the calendar year (measured since {from}) in which the feed delivered current or slightly delayed data; stale, errors, vanished and blocked count as unavailable. Traffic light: met from {target}, close from 90 %, below that not met. An operator with several feeds needs all of them together.
aufl.title: Data obligations in {name}
aufl.sub: Per operator: open feed, data age, availability in {year} (measured since {from}), zones, prices, licence, format.
aufl.none: No source is recorded in this municipality.
aufl.note: Based on the publicly reachable feeds; the check does not replace information from the operator. The target {target} matches usual obligations in special-use permits; the city's own obligation is decisive.
aus.title: Deadline calendar
aus.sub: Procedures by deadline, each row with source and check date (data/ausschreibungen.json, maintained by hand).
aus.how: Deadline = end of the application period or expiry of the current permit, as stated in the source. Cap, number of operators and fees as stated in the source; empty if not stated. Each row carries its check date.
aus.note: Not legal advice: deadlines and conditions may change; the city's linked source is decisive.
